const lead = $('Workflow Input').item.json;                                                                                                        
const raw = $input.item.json.status || 'unknown';                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                   
const statusMap = {                                                                                                                                
  safe:        'valid',                                                                                                                            
  role_account:'valid',                                                                                                                            
  catch_all:   'catch-all',                                                                                                                      
  invalid:     'discard',                                                                                                                          
  disabled:    'discard',
  inbox_full:  'discard',                                                                                                                          
  disposable:  'discard',                                                                                                                        
  spamtrap:    'discard',                                                                                                                          
  unknown:     'unknown'                                                                                                                           
};
                                                                                                                                                   
return {                                                                                                                                         
  json: {
    ...lead,
    validationProvider: 'reoon',
    validationRawStatus: raw,                                                                                                                      
    validationStatus: statusMap[raw] || 'discard'
  }                                                                                                                                                
};

const all = $input.all().map(i => i.json);                                                                                                                          
const inputCount = all.length;                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                    
const valid = all.filter(i => i.validationStatus === 'valid');
const catchAll = all.filter(i => i.validationStatus === 'catch-all');                                                                                               
const discarded = all.filter(i => i.validationStatus === 'discard');                                                                                                
 
// Catch-all cap: max 30% of sendable batch                                                                                                                         
const maxCatchAll = Math.floor((3 * valid.length) / 7);                                                                                                           
const cappedCatchAll = catchAll.slice(0, maxCatchAll);                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                  
const sendable = [...valid, ...cappedCatchAll];                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                  
const requestedLeadCount = all[0]?.requestedLeadCount || 0;                                                                                                         
const sopRate = requestedLeadCount > 0 ? sendable.length / requestedLeadCount : 0;                                                                                
const qualityRate = inputCount > 0 ? sendable.length / inputCount : 0;                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                    
const summary = {                                                                                                                                                   
  batchId: all[0]?.batchId,                                                                                                                                         
  requestedLeadCount,                                                                                                                                               
  stage4InputCount: inputCount,
  validCount: valid.length,                                                                                                                                         
  catchAllCount: cappedCatchAll.length,                                                                                                                           
  catchAllUncapped: catchAll.length,                                                                                                                                
  discardedCount: discarded.length,
  sendableCount: sendable.length,                                                                                                                                   
  sopRate: Math.round(sopRate * 100) / 100,                                                                                                                         
  qualityRate: Math.round(qualityRate * 100) / 100,
  gatePassed: sopRate >= 0.80                                                                                                                                       
};                                                                                                                                                                  
 
// Guard: if nothing is sendable, return one item so the False branch can fire                                                                                      
if (sendable.length === 0) {                                                                                                                                      
  return [{ json: { _summary: summary } }];                                                                                                                         
}                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                    
return sendable.map(item => ({                                                                                                                                      
  json: { ...item, _summary: summary }
}));

const summary = $input.first().json._summary;                                                                                                                                                                               
const sopPct = Math.round(summary.sopRate * 100);                                                                                                                   
const qualityPct = Math.round(summary.qualityRate * 100);                                                                                                           
const isAttritionFailure = summary.stage4InputCount < summary.requestedLeadCount * 0.80 && qualityPct >= 80;                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                    
const cause = isAttritionFailure
  ? `Likely cause: pipeline attrition. Only ${summary.stage4InputCount} of ${summary.requestedLeadCount} requested leads reached Stage 4. Email quality was         
${qualityPct}% — acceptable. Consider re-running with a higher lead count.`                                                                                         
  : `Likely cause: low email quality. Only ${qualityPct}% of Stage 4 leads validated as sendable.`;
                                                                                                                                                                    
const body = `Stage 4 Quality Gate FAILED — campaign blocked.                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                    
Batch ID: ${summary.batchId}                                                                                                                                        
Requested leads: ${summary.requestedLeadCount}                                                                                                                    
Received by Stage 4: ${summary.stage4InputCount}                                                                                                                    
Sendable (valid + catch-all): ${summary.sendableCount}
                                                                                                                                                                    
Gate: ${sopPct}% (sendable ÷ requested) — threshold: 80% — FAILED                                                                                                   
Quality-only rate: ${qualityPct}% (sendable ÷ Stage 4 input)                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                    
Breakdown:                                                                                                                                                        
  Valid: ${summary.validCount}                                                                                                                                      
  Catch-all: ${summary.catchAllCount} (${summary.catchAllUncapped} before cap)                                                                                      
  Discarded: ${summary.discardedCount}
                                                                                                                                                                    
${cause}                                                                                                                                                            
 
No emails were sent.`;                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                  
return [{ json: { subject: `[OltaFlock] Validation failed – ${summary.batchId}`, body } }];
throw new Error('Quality gate failed — campaign blocked. Alert sent to operator.');
